fields.description: One River Point is an Ellington residential tower beside Dubai Water Canal in Business Bay, combining apartments with larger duplexes and penthouses. Shared facilities are arranged across the podium and canal-facing leisure areas.

overview: Canal-side apartments are complemented by duplex and penthouse layouts with more extensive outdoor areas.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, Dubai. Canal and skyline views depend on the selected unit, orientation and surrounding development.
research.priceNote: Property Finder states AED 3,380,828 as a starting reference, rounded to AED 3.4 million. This does not establish current developer inventory or a selected-unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The table follows the original branded guide. Confirm the selected unit’s current contract, instalment dates and charges before relying on this historical schedule.
research.handoverNote: The brief anticipates Q2 2027; Property Finder specifies June 2027. These are estimates, not confirmed key delivery.
